EmailTemplate.subject: Tomorrow - Driving Education Innovation in Australia - Live!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Join us on May 26th at 11:00 AM AEST for an exclusive Australia virtual roadshow to learn more about how digital innovation enables institutions to simplify the payments process and optimise the student experience.
Our panel will discuss current international student trends across the value chain, student centric recovery strategies, and embracing technology, platform collaboration, and digital payments to shape the future amidst the massive challenges facing the Australian sector today.
Speakers:
Mr Mark Lucas - Chair, International Student Education Agent Association & Co-Founder of IAE Global Ms Olivia Barnes - Regional Head Onshore, UTS College Mr Sean Yue - Global Payments & Partnerships Lead, Flywire Mr Rongyu Li - Deputy Vice-Chancellor & Vice President (External Engagement), University of Queensland
Register: https://more.flywire.com/q2-aus-higher-ed-virtual-roadshow.html?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email
If you can't make the live roadshow but would still like to view the content, please register, and we will share the recording.
